Liam: Heads up — someone left a pair of suspiciously comfy sneakers by the couch and I found them being used as a nap pillow. Who do I return these to? :sneakers: :zzz:
Ava: 😂 guilty. Those are mine, left them under my desk after the call. Please keep them safe? Also they make a great impromptu pillow. :pleading_face:
Priya: Return to Ava but also: chair lottery tonight? My chair is starting a squeak symphony and I'm ready to trade. :chair:️
Marcus: Ooo chair lottery. I call dibs on the sneaker-nap combo if it comes with a small blanket. :raised_hand:
DevBot: Reminder: communal areas are chill zones. If you're napping in the lounge, quick log with `/nap start` so the team knows not to deploy a surprise stand-up. :robot_face:
Felix: Also — shoutout to @Ava for grabbing catering last week. Gif storm incoming. :tada:
Ava: aw thanks! *posts GIF of a raccoon offering snacks* <https://giphy.com/gifs/snack-raccoon-3o7aD2saalBwwftBIY>
Priya: Quick poll: who wants a tiny "comfy-sneaker" shrine by the ficus? React with :+1: for yes, :heart: for no.
Marcus: :+1: also happy to add a miniature chair if we win.
Liam: :heart: — but only if it's placed near the coffee machine (strategic placement).
Felix: I labeled them "Ava's Nappers" with a sticky note and a tiny shoelace flag. Museum-quality. :museum: :laughing:
Ava: Incredible. Thanks y'all. Will reclaim shoes tomorrow unless someone runs off with my nap-pillow and starts a sneaker cult. :sweat_smile:
Liam: If sneaker cult starts, can we at least get matching hoodies? :hoodie:
Priya: Vote on hoodie color next week in #merch. For now, please label personal stuff. Mystery footwear saga closed (for now). :white_check_mark:
